products.name: Vellum
products.note: Personal AI assistant; on-device Mac app or cloud; cross-app memory; privacy-first design

profile_text.body:
Vellum describes itself as a personal AI assistant designed to know the user deeply, evolve alongside them, and remain entirely theirs. The product runs as an on-device Mac application or in the cloud, with a stated emphasis on privacy-first design and cross-app memory that the company characterizes as remembering the way a person does.

The Vellum assistant is presented as capable of handling a range of productivity tasks, including processing and auto-replying to emails, rescheduling calendar events, drafting documents, delegating tasks with shared context, compiling research briefings, summarizing communication threads, tracking at-risk project items, and booking travel. The site's own examples show the assistant processing 47 emails with 41 auto-replied, rescheduling slots, drafting board deck summaries, and coordinating travel bookings, illustrating the breadth of delegation the product is positioned to support.

The held facts classify Vellum under enterprise AI platforms and agent orchestration, though the site's own language leans toward individual and personal use. No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations are recorded for the company at this time.
